# Overview

This script analyses the BRUVS fish data together with the environmental data
of each deployment, starting from the two raw tables, and reproduces:

| Output | Content |
|---|---|
| Figure 7  | Sample-based species rarefaction curves, inside vs. outside the canyons |
| Figure 8  | GAM of species richness: effects of depth, temperature, canyon position and canyon |
| Figure 9  | Total MaxN by canyon and position, and against depth (observed data) |
| Figure S3 | Substrate type by depth range in each canyon |
| Figure S4 | Redundancy analysis (RDA) of the fish community |
| Tables    | Depth by group; species list; rarefaction summary; GAM model selection (ML), summaries and diagnostics; Total MaxN GAM output; composition tests (PERMANOVA, partial RDA); RDA tests |



```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, readr, stringr, purrr
library(lubridate)   # deployment dates
library(vegan)       # specaccum, decostand, rda, adonis2
library(mgcv)        # GAMs
library(ggrepel)     # non-overlapping labels in the RDA biplot
library(patchwork)   # multi-panel figure assembly
has_dharma <- requireNamespace("DHARMa", quietly = TRUE)   # residual diagnostics
if (has_dharma) library(DHARMa) else message("DHARMa not installed: DHARMa checks skipped")
```

# 1. Input files and settings

All paths are relative to this script (the `scripts` folder); the input
files are in `data/bruvs` and all outputs are written to `outputs`.

```{r paths}
data_dir    <- file.path("..", "data", "bruvs")
fish_file   <- file.path(data_dir, "bruvs_maxn.csv")          # one row per taxon per deployment
deploy_file <- file.path(data_dir, "bruvs_deployments.csv")   # one row per deployment

# Output folder for figures, tables and the saved workspace
out_dir <- file.path("..", "outputs")
fig_dir <- out_dir
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

missing <- c(fish_file, deploy_file)[!file.exists(c(fish_file, deploy_file))]
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing input file(s):\n", paste(missing, collapse = "\n"))
```

```{r settings}
canyon_levels   <- c("Eilat", "Shlomo", "Princess")
location_levels <- c("In", "Out")

canyon_cols   <- c("Eilat" = "steelblue", "Shlomo" = "darkorange", "Princess" = "darkgreen")
location_cols <- c("In" = "#d95f02", "Out" = "#7570b3")

substrate_bin  <- 20    # depth bins of Figure S3 (m)
rda_arrow_scale <- 1.4  # stretch of the arrows in the RDA biplot
shared_depth_max <- 150 # upper limit of the depth range sampled both inside and outside (m)
maxn_extreme     <- 30  # Total MaxN sensitivity: deployments with Total MaxN > 30 removed
n_perm           <- 999 # permutations of the RDA / PERMANOVA tests

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure style – used by every figure so that all figures look the same
# (identical to Scripts 1 and 2)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Font: Times New Roman, requested through R's generic "serif" family.
# "serif" is understood by every R graphics device (screen, png, pdf,
# cairo_pdf, ragg) and is drawn as Times New Roman on Windows (Times on
# macOS). Asking for "Times New Roman" by name makes the standard pdf() and
# png() devices fail silently, which produces empty files.
font_family <- "serif"

# Text sizes (pt) shared by all figures
fig_sizes <- list(
  axis_title   = 18,   # axis titles
  axis_text    = 14,   # axis numbers
  strip        = 16,   # panel title strips
  legend_title = 16,
  legend_text  = 14,
  legend_key   = 1.3,  # size of the legend colour boxes (lines)
  tag          = 18,   # panel letters
  annotation   = 4.5   # text inside panels (mm, ggplot units)
)

theme_fig <- theme(
  text         = element_text(family = font_family),
  axis.title   = element_text(size = fig_sizes$axis_title),
  axis.text    = element_text(size = fig_sizes$axis_text, colour = "black"),
  strip.text   = element_text(size = fig_sizes$strip),
  legend.title = element_text(size = fig_sizes$legend_title, face = "bold"),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = fig_sizes$legend_text),
  plot.tag     = element_text(size = fig_sizes$tag, face = "bold")
)

# Text drawn inside the panels (geom_text / geom_label) uses the same font
update_geom_defaults("text",  list(family = font_family))
update_geom_defaults("label", list(family = font_family))

# Single y-axis title (left) and x-axis title (bottom) for a whole figure
add_figure_titles <- function(panels, y = NULL, x = NULL, x_hjust = 0.5,
                              size = fig_sizes$axis_title) {
  wrap_elements(panel = panels) +
    labs(tag = y, caption = x) +
    theme(text              = element_text(family = font_family),
          plot.tag          = element_text(angle = 90, size = size),
          plot.tag.position = "left",
          plot.caption      = element_text(size = size, hjust = x_hjust))
}

# Hide axis numbers but keep their space, so that panels stay evenly spaced
hide_axis_text <- function(axis = c("x", "y")) {
  axis <- match.arg(axis)
  if (axis == "x") {
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "transparent"),
          axis.ticks.x = element_line(colour = "transparent"))
  } else {
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "transparent"),
          axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = "transparent"))
  }
}

# Save a figure as PDF (vector, embedded font), 300-dpi PNG and 300-dpi TIFF.
# Always pass the figure object explicitly: ggsave() without `plot =` saves
# ggplot2's "last plot", which for a patchwork figure can be one of its
# internal pieces (e.g. the empty legend panel).
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  has_ragg   <- requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)
  pdf_device <- if (capabilities("cairo")) cairo_pdf else "pdf"
  files <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, c(".pdf", ".png", ".tiff")))
  start <- Sys.time() - 1

  ggsave(files[1], plot, width = width, height = height, device = pdf_device)
  ggsave(files[2], plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white",
         device = if (has_ragg) ragg::agg_png else "png")
  ggsave(files[3], plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white",
         device = if (has_ragg) ragg::agg_tiff else "tiff", compression = "lzw")

  # Windows cannot overwrite a file that is open in another program (image
  # viewer, PDF reader, Explorer preview pane). Check that every file was
  # really rewritten and say so if not.
  not_updated <- files[is.na(file.mtime(files)) | file.mtime(files) < start]
  if (length(not_updated) > 0) {
    warning("Not updated (probably open in another program - close it and run again):\n  ",
            paste(not_updated, collapse = "\n  "), call. = FALSE)
  } else {
    message("Saved: ", paste(basename(files), collapse = ", "))
  }

  set_last_plot(plot)   # so that a later ggsave() without `plot =` also saves this figure
  invisible(plot)
}

# Panel letters in the top-left corner of each panel
tag_inside <- function(x = 0.01, y = 0.99, size = fig_sizes$tag) {
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = size, face = "bold"), plot.tag.position = c(x, y))
}

# Axis labels with at most two decimals, trailing zeros dropped
label_2dec  <- function(x) sub("\\.?0+$", "", sprintf("%.2f", x))

# Legend drawn from a separate, otherwise empty plot, so that it appears once
# and looks the same in every ggplot2 version
# `scale` enlarges text and keys (e.g. 1.25 = 25 % larger than the default)
legend_panel <- function(p, scale = 1) {
  wrap_elements(full = p + theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "left",
          legend.key.size = unit(fig_sizes$legend_key * scale, "lines"),
          text         = element_text(family = font_family),
          legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = fig_sizes$legend_title * scale),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = fig_sizes$legend_text * scale)))
}

theme_panel <- theme_classic() + theme_fig
```

# 2. Load and clean the data

## 2.1 Fish observations

```{r load-fish}
fish_raw   <- read.csv(fish_file, check.names = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
deploy_raw <- read.csv(deploy_file, check.names = FALSE)

# Text clean-up: some species names contain non-breaking spaces
# (e.g. "Choerodon robustus" typed twice, once with each kind of space),
# which would turn one species into two different columns.
clean_text <- function(x) na_if(str_squish(gsub(" ", " ", x)), "")

fish <- fish_raw %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ iconv(.x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")),
         across(c(OpCode, Canyon, Location, Family, Species), clean_text)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OpCode), !is.na(MaxN), MaxN >= 0)   # empty deployments have no fish rows

# Family names: common names, subfamilies and synonyms in the raw table are
# replaced by one accepted family name, so that every species has one family
family_fix <- c("Angelfishes" = "Pomacanthidae", "Bodianina" = "Labridae",
                "Naucratinae" = "Carangidae", "Epinephelidae" = "Serranidae")
fish <- fish %>% mutate(Family = recode(Family, !!!family_fix),
                        Species = str_replace(Species, "^chanos chanos$", "Chanos chanos"))
stopifnot(all(count(distinct(filter(fish, !is.na(Species)), Species, Family), Species)$n == 1))
```

## 2.2 Inside / outside the canyon (In / Out) of every deployment

The position is given in both raw tables (`Canyon_Location` in
`bruvs_deployments.csv`, `Location` in `bruvs_maxn.csv`). The script stops if a
deployment is missing from one of the files or the two files disagree.

```{r location}
location_check <- full_join(
  deploy_raw %>% transmute(OpCode = clean_text(OpCode), Location_deploy = clean_text(Canyon_Location)),
  fish_raw   %>% transmute(OpCode = clean_text(OpCode), Location_fish   = clean_text(Location)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(OpCode)) %>% distinct(),
  by = "OpCode")

unclear <- location_check %>%
  filter(is.na(Location_deploy) | is.na(Location_fish) | Location_deploy != Location_fish |
         OpCode %in% OpCode[duplicated(OpCode)])
if (nrow(unclear) > 0) {
  print(unclear)
  stop("Unclear In/Out position for the deployments above - check the two files")
}
location_table <- location_check %>% transmute(OpCode, Location = Location_deploy)

fish <- fish %>% select(-Location) %>% left_join(location_table, by = "OpCode")
```

## 2.3 One row per deployment

Species richness = number of species recorded in the deployment (records
identified to species level only); total MaxN = sum of the MaxN of all
records, including those not identified to species. Deployments without fish
get 0.

```{r deployments}
fish_summary <- fish %>%
  group_by(OpCode) %>%
  summarise(Richness   = n_distinct(Species[MaxN > 0 & !is.na(Species)]),
            Total_MaxN = sum(MaxN),
            MaxN_unidentified = sum(MaxN[is.na(Species)]),
            .groups = "drop")

deployments <- deploy_raw %>%
  transmute(OpCode = clean_text(OpCode),
            Canyon = clean_text(Canyon),
            date        = dmy(date),
            year        = year(date),
            Survey      = factor(if_else(year >= 2025, "2025-2026", "2020-2022")),
            system_id   = factor(system_id),
            lat = lat_y, lon = lon_x,
            depth       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(depth)),
            temperature = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(temperature)),
            Substrate   = na_if(clean_text(Substrate), "na")) %>%
  left_join(location_table, by = "OpCode") %>%
  left_join(fish_summary, by = "OpCode") %>%
  mutate(Richness   = replace_na(Richness, 0L),
         Total_MaxN = replace_na(Total_MaxN, 0L),
         MaxN_unidentified = replace_na(MaxN_unidentified, 0L),
         Canyon     = factor(Canyon, levels = canyon_levels),
         Location   = factor(Location, levels = location_levels),
         Substrate  = factor(Substrate, levels = c("Hard", "Mixed", "Soft")))

stopifnot(!anyNA(deployments$Canyon), !anyNA(deployments$Location), !anyNA(deployments$date))

# The deployment date is also encoded in the OpCode (ddmmyy): check that both agree
date_in_code <- dmy(str_extract(deployments$OpCode, "\\d{6}"))
if (any(date_in_code != deployments$date))
  warning("Date column and OpCode disagree for: ",
          paste(deployments$OpCode[date_in_code != deployments$date], collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)

deployments %>% count(Canyon, Location) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Location, values_from = n) %>% knitr::kable()
```

## 2.4 Sampling design: depth, survey and date of the deployments (Table S6)

```{r design-table}
design_table <- deployments %>%
  group_by(Canyon, Location) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            depth_min = min(depth), depth_median = median(depth), depth_max = max(depth),
            n_deeper_160m = sum(depth > 160),
            n_survey_2020_2022 = sum(Survey == "2020-2022"),
            n_survey_2025_2026 = sum(Survey == "2025-2026"),
            months = paste(sort(unique(month(date))), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop")
design_table %>% knitr::kable()
write_csv(design_table, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_BRUV_design.csv"))

# Every deployment, for the Supporting Information
write_csv(deployments %>% arrange(date) %>%
            select(OpCode, Canyon, Location, date, system_id, depth, temperature, Substrate,
                   Richness, Total_MaxN),
          file.path(fig_dir, "Table_BRUV_deployments.csv"))

# Distance between deployments of the same day (independence of the drops)
dist_km <- as.matrix(dist(cbind(deployments$lon * cos(29.5 * pi / 180) * 111.32,
                                deployments$lat * 110.57)))
same_day <- outer(deployments$date, deployments$date, "==")
diag(same_day) <- FALSE
cat("Minimum distance between deployments of the same day:",
    round(1000 * min(dist_km[same_day])), "m\n")
```

## 2.5 Community matrix and species list (Table S5)

Presence (1) / absence (0) of every species (records identified to species
level) in every deployment, including the deployments without fish.

```{r community}
community <- fish %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), MaxN > 0) %>%
  distinct(OpCode, Species) %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)

community <- deployments %>% select(OpCode) %>%
  left_join(community, by = "OpCode") %>%
  mutate(across(-OpCode, ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("OpCode") %>%
  as.matrix()

stopifnot(identical(rownames(community), deployments$OpCode))
cat(ncol(community), "species in", nrow(community), "deployments;",
    sum(colSums(community[deployments$Location == "In", ]) > 0), "inside,",
    sum(colSums(community[deployments$Location == "Out", ]) > 0), "outside\n")

# Species list: number of deployments with the species and maximum MaxN,
# per canyon and position
species_list <- fish %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species), MaxN > 0) %>%
  select(OpCode, Family, Species, MaxN, Location) %>%
  left_join(select(deployments, OpCode, Canyon), by = "OpCode") %>%
  mutate(group = paste(Canyon, Location)) %>%
  group_by(Family, Species, group) %>%
  summarise(cell = paste0(n_distinct(OpCode), " (", max(MaxN), ")"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = cell, values_fill = "") %>%
  left_join(fish %>% filter(!is.na(Species), MaxN > 0) %>%
              select(OpCode, Species) %>%
              left_join(select(deployments, OpCode, depth), by = "OpCode") %>%
              group_by(Species) %>%
              summarise(n_deployments = n_distinct(OpCode),
                        depth_range = paste0(min(depth), "–", max(depth)), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "Species") %>%
  select(Family, Species, n_deployments, depth_range,
         any_of(paste(rep(canyon_levels, each = 2), location_levels))) %>%
  arrange(Family, Species)
write_csv(species_list, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_species_list.csv"))
nrow(species_list)
```

# 3. Figure 7 – sample-based species rarefaction curves

Sample-based rarefaction curves (`vegan::specaccum(method = "exact")`): the
expected number of species in a random subset of *m* deployments, computed
analytically from the species incidences (Colwell et al. 2004, Ecology 85:
2717–2727). Shading: ± 1.96 SD of the expected richness. The SD is
unconditional (`conditioned = FALSE`): the observed deployments are treated as
a sample from a larger assemblage, whose total richness is estimated with the
Chao2 estimator (`gamma = "chao"`); the SD therefore does not shrink to zero at
the full number of deployments.

```{r fig7, fig.width=15, fig.height=6.5}
rarefaction <- function(rows, ...) {
  rc <- specaccum(community[rows, , drop = FALSE], method = "exact",
                  conditioned = FALSE, gamma = "chao")
  tibble(Samples = rc$sites, Richness = rc$richness, SD = rc$sd, ...)
}

rare_all <- map_dfr(location_levels, function(l)
  rarefaction(deployments$Location == l, Location = l))

rare_canyon <- expand_grid(Canyon = canyon_levels, Location = location_levels) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(Canyon, Location)
    rarefaction(deployments$Canyon == Canyon & deployments$Location == Location,
                Canyon = Canyon, Location = Location))

# Number of deployments in each curve, written in the panel titles
n_label <- function(d) paste0("In = ", sum(d$Location == "In"), ", Out = ", sum(d$Location == "Out"))
strip_all    <- paste0("All canyons\n", n_label(deployments))
strip_canyon <- deployments %>% group_by(Canyon) %>%
  summarise(label = paste0(first(Canyon), "\nIn = ", sum(Location == "In"),
                           ", Out = ", sum(Location == "Out")), .groups = "drop")

rare_all    <- rare_all %>% mutate(Panel = strip_all)
rare_canyon <- rare_canyon %>%
  mutate(Canyon = factor(Canyon, levels = canyon_levels)) %>%
  left_join(strip_canyon, by = "Canyon") %>%
  mutate(Panel = factor(label, levels = strip_canyon$label))

rarefaction_panel <- function(d) {
  ggplot(d, aes(Samples, Richness, colour = Location, fill = Location)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, Richness - 1.96 * SD), ymax = Richness + 1.96 * SD),
                alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ Panel, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = location_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = location_cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_panel +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6))
}

p6A <- rarefaction_panel(rare_all)
p6B <- rarefaction_panel(rare_canyon) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 20, by = 4))

legend_location <- legend_panel(
  ggplot(tibble(Location = factor(location_levels, levels = location_levels), x = 0, y = 0),
         aes(x, y, colour = Location, fill = Location)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y, ymax = y), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = location_cols, name = "Position:",
                        guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = location_cols, name = "Position:"),
  scale = 1.2
)

figure7_panels <- p6A + p6B + legend_location +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.1, 0.32)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B", ""))) &
  tag_inside(0.005, 0.995)

figure7 <- add_figure_titles(figure7_panels, y = "Expected species richness",
                             x = "Number of deployments", x_hjust = 0.42)
figure7

save_figure(figure7, "Figure 7", width = 15, height = 6.5)
```

## 3.1 Rarefaction summary and the shared depth range (reported in the text)

Inside drops reach 260 m, outside drops (except one at 193 m) end at 145 m.
To check that the inside–outside difference is not caused by the deeper
inside drops, the rarefaction is repeated with the deployments of the depth
range sampled both inside and outside (≤ `shared_depth_max` m).

```{r rarefaction-summary}
rare_summary <- function(rows, label) {
  map_dfr(location_levels, function(l) {
    r  <- rows & deployments$Location == l
    rc <- specaccum(community[r, , drop = FALSE], method = "exact", conditioned = FALSE, gamma = "chao")
    tibble(Data = label, Location = l, n_deployments = sum(r),
           Species_observed = sum(colSums(community[r, , drop = FALSE]) > 0),
           Chao2 = unname(specpool(community[r, , drop = FALSE])$chao),
           m = list(rc))
  }) %>%
    mutate(m_common = min(n_deployments)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(S_at_common = m$richness[m_common],
           CI_low  = S_at_common - 1.96 * m$sd[m_common],
           CI_high = S_at_common + 1.96 * m$sd[m_common]) %>%
    ungroup() %>% select(-m)
}
rarefaction_table <- bind_rows(
  rare_summary(rep(TRUE, nrow(deployments)), "All deployments"),
  rare_summary(deployments$depth <= shared_depth_max, paste0("Depth <= ", shared_depth_max, " m"))
)
rarefaction_table %>% knitr::kable(digits = 1)
write_csv(rarefaction_table, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_rarefaction_summary.csv"))

# Species recorded only in deployments deeper than 160 m
deep_only <- colSums(community[deployments$depth > 160, , drop = FALSE]) > 0 &
             colSums(community[deployments$depth <= 160, , drop = FALSE]) == 0
cat("Species recorded only deeper than 160 m:", paste(names(which(deep_only)), collapse = "; "), "\n")
```

# 4. GAMs – species richness and total MaxN

Species richness: Poisson GAM. Total MaxN: negative-binomial GAM
(over-dispersed counts). The same four candidate structures are fitted to
both responses; all include canyon and position (In / Out) as fixed effects
and smooths of depth and near-bottom temperature, and they differ in whether
the smooths are shared by all deployments or fitted separately for each
position (`by = Location`) or canyon (`by = Canyon`):

| Model | Smooths |
|---|---|
| 0 | none (intercept only) |
| 1 | s(depth) + s(temperature) |
| 2 | s(depth, by = Canyon) + s(temperature, by = Canyon) |
| 3 | s(depth, by = Location) + s(temperature, by = Location) |
| 4 | s(depth, by = Location) + s(temperature) |

## 4.1 Model selection (AIC of maximum-likelihood fits; Table S8; sensitivity in Table S9)

AIC values are compared between models fitted by maximum likelihood
(`method = "ML"`), because REML likelihoods are not comparable between models
with different fixed effects. The lowest-AIC model is then refitted with REML
for the parameter estimates, smooth tests and predictions.

```{r candidate-models}
smooth_terms <- list(
  "1" = "s(depth, k = 5) + s(temperature, k = 5)",
  "2" = "s(depth, by = Canyon, k = 5) + s(temperature, by = Canyon, k = 5)",
  "3" = "s(depth, by = Location, k = 5) + s(temperature, by = Location, k = 5)",
  "4" = "s(depth, by = Location, k = 5) + s(temperature, k = 5)"
)
model_formula <- function(response, id) {
  if (id == "0") return(as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1")))
  as.formula(paste(response, "~ Canyon + Location +", smooth_terms[[id]]))
}
fit_candidates <- function(response, family, data, method = "ML") {
  ids <- c("0", names(smooth_terms))
  set_names(map(ids, ~ gam(model_formula(response, .x), family = family, data = data, method = method)),
            ids)
}

aic_table_of <- function(models, response, prefix) {
  tibble(Response = response,
         Model    = paste0(prefix, names(models)),
         Formula  = map_chr(models, ~ paste(deparse(formula(.x), width.cutoff = 500), collapse = "")),
         df       = map_dbl(models, ~ attr(logLik(.x), "df")),
         AIC      = map_dbl(models, AIC),
         Deviance_explained = map_dbl(models, ~ summary(.x)$dev.expl),
         n        = map_int(models, ~ nrow(.x$model))) %>%
    mutate(Delta_AIC  = AIC - min(AIC),
           AIC_weight = exp(-Delta_AIC / 2) / sum(exp(-Delta_AIC / 2))) %>%
    arrange(AIC)
}

ml_richness <- fit_candidates("Richness", poisson(), deployments)
ml_maxn     <- fit_candidates("Total_MaxN", nb(), deployments)

# Total MaxN without the deployments with extreme counts (sensitivity)
deployments_no_extreme <- filter(deployments, Total_MaxN <= maxn_extreme)
ml_maxn_sens <- fit_candidates("Total_MaxN", nb(), deployments_no_extreme)
cat("Total MaxN sensitivity: removed", sum(deployments$Total_MaxN > maxn_extreme),
    "deployments with Total MaxN >", maxn_extreme, "\n")

# Table S8: model selection for both responses (all 56 deployments)
aic_table <- bind_rows(
  aic_table_of(ml_richness,  "Species richness", "S"),
  aic_table_of(ml_maxn,      "Total MaxN", "T")
)
aic_table %>% select(-Formula) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 2)
write_csv(aic_table, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_GAM_AIC.csv"))

# Table S9: Total MaxN sensitivity analysis (deployments with Total MaxN > maxn_extreme removed)
aic_table_sens <- aic_table_of(ml_maxn_sens, paste0("Total MaxN (Total MaxN <= ", maxn_extreme, ")"), "T")
aic_table_sens %>% select(-Formula) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 2)
write_csv(aic_table_sens, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_GAM_MaxN_sensitivity_AIC.csv"))

# Sensitivity (Table S8, last row): model S3 refitted with survey (2020-2022 vs. 2025-2026)
# as an additional parametric term, to test whether the canyon effects reflect the survey.
# Not part of the candidate set: Delta AIC is relative to S3 and no Akaike weight is given.
ml_richness_survey <- gam(update(model_formula("Richness", "3"), . ~ . + Survey),
                          family = poisson(), data = deployments, method = "ML")
survey_sensitivity <- tibble(
  Response  = "Species richness",
  Model     = "S3 + survey",
  Formula   = paste(deparse(formula(ml_richness_survey), width.cutoff = 500), collapse = ""),
  df        = attr(logLik(ml_richness_survey), "df"),
  AIC       = AIC(ml_richness_survey),
  Deviance_explained = summary(ml_richness_survey)$dev.expl,
  n         = nrow(ml_richness_survey$model),
  Delta_AIC = AIC(ml_richness_survey) - AIC(ml_richness[["3"]]),
  p_survey  = summary(ml_richness_survey)$p.table["Survey2025-2026", "Pr(>|z|)"]
)
survey_sensitivity %>% select(-Formula) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
write_csv(survey_sensitivity, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_GAM_survey_sensitivity.csv"))
```

```{r selected-models}
# Lowest-AIC model of each response (the null model included)
best_id <- function(models) names(models)[which.min(map_dbl(models, AIC))]
selected_richness <- best_id(ml_richness)
selected_maxn     <- best_id(ml_maxn)
cat("Species richness: lowest AIC = model S", selected_richness, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Total MaxN:       lowest AIC = model T", selected_maxn, "\n", sep = "")

# Richness: selected model refitted with REML
model_richness <- gam(model_formula("Richness", selected_richness), family = poisson(),
                      data = deployments, method = "REML")

# Total MaxN: if the null model is best, no explanatory model is interpreted;
# the full common-smooth model (T1) is reported in the SI for completeness

model_maxn  <- gam(model_formula("Total_MaxN", maxn_si_id), family = nb(),
                   data = deployments, method = "REML")
model_maxn_sens <- gam(model_formula("Total_MaxN", maxn_si_id), family = nb(),
                       data = deployments_no_extreme, method = "REML")

summary(model_richness)
concurvity(model_richness)
summary(model_maxn)
```

## 4.2 Model diagnostics

`gam.check()` (convergence, basis dimension k' and k-index of every smooth)
and simulation-based residual checks with DHARMa (dispersion, uniformity,
zero inflation and outliers), for the richness model and for the Total MaxN
model reported in the SI. Spatial autocorrelation of the richness residuals is
tested with Moran's I (inverse-distance weights; permutation test).

```{r diagnostics-mgcv, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
set.seed(5)   # the k-index p-values are based on random permutations
par(mfrow = c(2, 2)); gam.check(model_richness, rep = 500)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2)); gam.check(model_maxn,     rep = 500)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

k_table <- function(model, response) {
  as_tibble(k.check(model), rownames = "Term") %>%
    transmute(Response = response, Term,
              k_prime = `k'`, edf, k_index = `k-index`, p_value = `p-value`,
              Converged = model$converged,
              REML_convergence = model$outer.info$conv)
}
diagnostics_k <- bind_rows(k_table(model_richness, "Species richness"),
                           k_table(model_maxn,     "Total MaxN"))
diagnostics_k %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
write_csv(diagnostics_k, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_GAM_diagnostics_k.csv"))
```

```{r diagnostics-dharma, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
simulate_gam <- function(model, n_sim) {
  mu  <- fitted(model)
  fam <- model$family$family
  if (fam == "poisson") {
    replicate(n_sim, rpois(length(mu), mu))
  } else if (startsWith(fam, "Negative Binomial")) {
    theta <- model$family$getTheta(TRUE)
    replicate(n_sim, rnbinom(length(mu), mu = mu, size = theta))
  } else stop("simulate_gam(): family not supported: ", fam)
}

if (has_dharma) {
  dharma_residuals <- function(model, seed, n_sim = 1000) {
    set.seed(seed)
    createDHARMa(simulatedResponse       = simulate_gam(model, n_sim),
                 observedResponse        = model$y,
                 fittedPredictedResponse = fitted(model),
                 integerResponse         = TRUE)
  }
  res_richness <- dharma_residuals(model_richness, seed = 6)
  res_maxn     <- dharma_residuals(model_maxn,     seed = 7)
  plot(res_richness, title = "Species richness")
  plot(res_maxn,     title = "Total MaxN")

  dharma_tests <- function(res, response) {
    tests <- list(
      "Dispersion"           = testDispersion(res, plot = FALSE),
      "Uniformity (KS)"      = testUniformity(res, plot = FALSE),
      "Zero inflation"       = testZeroInflation(res, plot = FALSE),
      "Outliers (bootstrap)" = testOutliers(res, type = "bootstrap", plot = FALSE)
    )
    tibble(Response = response, Test = names(tests),
           Statistic = map_dbl(tests, ~ unname(.x$statistic[1])),
           p_value   = map_dbl(tests, "p.value"))
  }
  diagnostics_dharma <- bind_rows(dharma_tests(res_richness, "Species richness"),
                                  dharma_tests(res_maxn,     "Total MaxN"))
} else {
  diagnostics_dharma <- tibble(Response = character(), Test = character(),
                               Statistic = numeric(), p_value = numeric())
}

# Moran's I of the deviance residuals of the richness model
morans_i <- function(r, W) {
  z <- r - mean(r)
  (length(r) / sum(W)) * sum(W * outer(z, z)) / sum(z^2)
}
W <- 1 / dist_km; diag(W) <- 0; W[!is.finite(W)] <- 0
r_dev <- residuals(model_richness, type = "deviance")
I_obs <- morans_i(r_dev, W)
set.seed(8)
I_perm <- replicate(999, morans_i(sample(r_dev), W))
diagnostics_dharma <- bind_rows(diagnostics_dharma,
  tibble(Response = "Species richness", Test = "Moran's I (inverse distance, 999 permutations)",
         Statistic = I_obs, p_value = (sum(I_perm >= I_obs) + 1) / 1000))
diagnostics_dharma %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
write_csv(diagnostics_dharma, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_GAM_diagnostics_DHARMa.csv"))
```

## 4.3 Model summaries and differences between groups (Tables S8, S9)

Differences between positions and canyons are average predictions on the
response scale (all deployments set to one level, minus all deployments set
to the reference level), with 95 % CI from the delta method. These are the
values shown in Figure 8C and 8F and reported in the text; the parametric
coefficients (log scale, at the centred smooths) are given in the summary
table.

```{r differences}
# Difference in the average prediction between each level of `variable` and
# the reference level, with 95 % CI (= marginaleffects::avg_comparisons(type = "response"))
level_differences <- function(model, data, variable,
                              reference = levels(data[[variable]])[1]) {
  b <- coef(model); V <- vcov(model)
  inv <- model$family$linkinv; mu_eta <- model$family$mu.eta
  lv <- levels(data[[variable]])
  average_at <- function(level) {
    nd <- data; nd[[variable]] <- factor(level, levels = lv)
    X <- predict(model, newdata = nd, type = "lpmatrix"); eta <- drop(X %*% b)
    list(est = mean(inv(eta)), grad = colMeans(X * mu_eta(eta)))
  }
  ref <- average_at(reference)
  map_dfr(lv, function(l) {
    a <- average_at(l); d <- a$est - ref$est; g <- a$grad - ref$grad
    se <- sqrt(drop(g %*% V %*% g))
    tibble(level = l, reference_mean = ref$est, estimate = d,
           conf.low = d - 1.96 * se, conf.high = d + 1.96 * se,
           percent = 100 * d / ref$est)
  }) %>%
    mutate(across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high, percent), ~ if_else(level == reference, 0, .x)),
           level = factor(level, levels = lv))
}

d <- deployments
diff_rich_location <- level_differences(model_richness, d, "Location", "In")
diff_rich_canyon   <- level_differences(model_richness, d, "Canyon",   "Eilat")
diff_maxn_location <- level_differences(model_maxn,     d, "Location", "In")
diff_maxn_canyon   <- level_differences(model_maxn,     d, "Canyon",   "Eilat")

differences <- bind_rows(
  diff_rich_location %>% mutate(Response = "Species richness", Comparison = "vs In"),
  diff_rich_canyon   %>% mutate(Response = "Species richness", Comparison = "vs Eilat"),
  diff_maxn_location %>% mutate(Response = "Total MaxN (model T1, SI only)", Comparison = "vs In"),
  diff_maxn_canyon   %>% mutate(Response = "Total MaxN (model T1, SI only)", Comparison = "vs Eilat")
) %>% relocate(Response, Comparison)
differences %>% knitr::kable(digits = 2)
write_csv(differences, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_GAM_differences.csv"))

gam_table <- function(model, response) {
  s <- summary(model)
  bind_rows(
    as_tibble(s$p.table, rownames = "Term") %>%
      transmute(Response = response, Term, Type = "parametric",
                Estimate, SE = `Std. Error`, Statistic = `z value`, p = `Pr(>|z|)`),
    as_tibble(s$s.table, rownames = "Term") %>%
      transmute(Response = response, Term, Type = "smooth",
                edf, Ref.df, Statistic = Chi.sq, p = `p-value`)
  ) %>% mutate(Deviance_explained = s$dev.expl, n = s$n)
}
write_csv(bind_rows(gam_table(model_richness,  paste0("Species richness (S", selected_richness, ")")),
                    gam_table(model_maxn,      paste0("Total MaxN (T", maxn_si_id, ")")),
                    gam_table(model_maxn_sens, paste0("Total MaxN (T", maxn_si_id,
                                                      ", Total MaxN <= ", maxn_extreme, ")"))),
          file.path(fig_dir, "Table_GAM_summaries.csv"))
```

# 5. Figure 8 – GAM of species richness

Row 1: effect of depth and temperature inside and outside the canyons, and
the difference between positions. Row 2: the same by canyon, and the
difference of each canyon from Eilat. Lines: average prediction over all
deployments with the focal variable set to the plotted value (response scale,
95 % CI); each curve is drawn only over the range of the variable observed in
that group. Points: observed deployments.

```{r prediction-function}
# Average prediction over all deployments with `x_var` set to each value and
# `by_var` set to the group (delta-method 95 % CI)
average_prediction <- function(model, data, x_var, by_var, n_grid = 100) {
  b <- coef(model); V <- vcov(model)
  inv <- model$family$linkinv; mu_eta <- model$family$mu.eta
  map_dfr(levels(data[[by_var]]), function(g) {
    obs <- data[[x_var]][data[[by_var]] == g]
    grid <- seq(min(obs, na.rm = TRUE), max(obs, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n_grid)
    map_dfr(grid, function(x) {
      nd <- data; nd[[x_var]] <- x; nd[[by_var]] <- factor(g, levels = levels(data[[by_var]]))
      X <- predict(model, newdata = nd, type = "lpmatrix"); eta <- drop(X %*% b)
      est <- mean(inv(eta)); grad <- colMeans(X * mu_eta(eta)); se <- sqrt(drop(grad %*% V %*% grad))
      tibble(x = x, group = g, predicted = est,
             conf.low = max(0, est - 1.96 * se), conf.high = est + 1.96 * se)
    })
  }) %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = levels(data[[by_var]])))
}

rich_depth_location <- average_prediction(model_richness, d, "depth",       "Location")
rich_temp_location  <- average_prediction(model_richness, d, "temperature", "Location")
rich_depth_canyon   <- average_prediction(model_richness, d, "depth",       "Canyon")
rich_temp_canyon    <- average_prediction(model_richness, d, "temperature", "Canyon")
```

```{r fig8, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
prediction_panel <- function(pred, x_var, by_var, cols, jitter = FALSE) {
  set.seed(2)   # reproducible jitter of the points
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = pred, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
                alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(data = pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = group), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = deployments,
               aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = Richness, colour = .data[[by_var]]),
               position = if (jitter) position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0) else "identity",
               size = 2.3, alpha = 0.55) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
    theme_panel
}

difference_panel <- function(diffs, cols) {
  ggplot(diffs, aes(x = level, colour = level)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(data = filter(diffs, conf.low != conf.high),
                  aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.5, linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate, ymax = estimate), width = 0.8, linewidth = 2.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = levels(diffs$level)) +
    theme_panel
}

group_legend <- function(levels, cols, title) {
  legend_panel(
    ggplot(tibble(g = factor(levels, levels = levels), x = 0, y = 0),
           aes(x, y, colour = g, fill = g)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y, ymax = y), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0) +
      geom_point(size = 2.3, alpha = 0) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cols, name = title,
                          guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = title),
    scale = 1.2)
}
```

Frequency of occurrence = proportion of the deployments of a depth range in

```{r figS3, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
                  ceiling(max(deployments$depth) / substrate_bin) * substrate_bin,
                  by = substrate_bin)

  filter(!is.na(Substrate), !is.na(depth)) %>%
  mutate(bin_index = as.integer(cut(depth, breaks = bin_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)),
         bin_low   = bin_breaks[bin_index],
```

# 8. Fish-community composition: RDA, PERMANOVA and partial RDA

Community: presence/absence of species. Deployments without any species-level
record (`r sum(rowSums(community) == 0)`) or without a substrate class
(`r sum(is.na(deployments$Substrate))`) are excluded.

* RDA (Hellinger-transformed) constrained by temperature, depth and substrate,
  tested with 999 permutations (overall and by margin), with R² and adjusted R².
* Composition inside vs. outside and among canyons, after accounting for the
  environment: PERMANOVA (`adonis2`, Jaccard, marginal tests) with depth,
  temperature, substrate, canyon and position, and a partial RDA
  (community ~ canyon + position | depth + temperature + substrate).
  Homogeneity of multivariate dispersion between positions and among canyons
  is tested with `betadisper`.

```{r rda}
rda_rows <- complete.cases(deployments[, c("depth", "temperature", "Substrate")]) &
            rowSums(community) > 0
rda_data <- deployments[rda_rows, ]
community_pa <- community[rda_rows, ]
community_hellinger <- decostand(community_pa, method = "hellinger")
cat("Deployments in the composition analyses:", nrow(rda_data), "\n")

rda_model <- rda(community_hellinger ~ temperature + depth + Substrate, data = rda_data)
rda_r2 <- RsquareAdj(rda_model)
set.seed(3)
rda_test_overall <- anova(rda_model, permutations = n_perm)
rda_test_terms   <- anova(rda_model, by = "margin", permutations = n_perm)
rda_test_overall
rda_test_terms
vif.cca(rda_model)
cat(sprintf("RDA: R2 = %.3f, adjusted R2 = %.3f\n", rda_r2$r.squared, rda_r2$adj.r.squared))

write_csv(bind_rows(
  as_tibble(as.data.frame(rda_test_overall), rownames = "Term") %>% mutate(Test = "overall"),
  as_tibble(as.data.frame(rda_test_terms),   rownames = "Term") %>% mutate(Test = "by margin")) %>%
    mutate(R2 = rda_r2$r.squared, R2_adj = rda_r2$adj.r.squared),
  file.path(fig_dir, "Table_RDA_tests.csv"))
```

```{r composition-tests}
set.seed(10)
permanova <- adonis2(community_pa ~ depth + temperature + Substrate + Canyon + Location,
                     data = rda_data, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE,
                     by = "margin", permutations = n_perm)
permanova

partial_rda <- rda(community_hellinger ~ Canyon + Location +
                     Condition(depth + temperature + Substrate), data = rda_data)
set.seed(11)
partial_rda_test <- anova(partial_rda, by = "margin", permutations = n_perm)
partial_rda_test

jaccard <- vegdist(community_pa, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
set.seed(12)
disp_location <- permutest(betadisper(jaccard, rda_data$Location), permutations = n_perm)
disp_canyon   <- permutest(betadisper(jaccard, rda_data$Canyon),   permutations = n_perm)

# The same PERMANOVA within the depth range sampled both inside and outside
shared <- rda_data$depth <= shared_depth_max
set.seed(13)
permanova_shared <- adonis2(community_pa[shared, ] ~ depth + temperature + Substrate + Canyon + Location,
                            data = rda_data[shared, ], method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE,
                            by = "margin", permutations = n_perm)
permanova_shared

tidy_perm <- function(x, test) as_tibble(as.data.frame(x), rownames = "Term") %>% mutate(Test = test)
composition_tests <- bind_rows(
  tidy_perm(permanova, "PERMANOVA (Jaccard), marginal"),
  tidy_perm(permanova_shared, paste0("PERMANOVA (Jaccard), marginal, depth <= ", shared_depth_max, " m")),
  tidy_perm(partial_rda_test, "Partial RDA (Hellinger) | depth + temperature + substrate, marginal"),
  tidy_perm(disp_location$tab, "Dispersion (betadisper) between positions"),
  tidy_perm(disp_canyon$tab,   "Dispersion (betadisper) among canyons")
)
composition_tests %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)
write_csv(composition_tests, file.path(fig_dir, "Table_composition_tests.csv"))
```

# 9. Figure S4 – RDA biplot

Site scores and biplot scores with scaling 2 (`vegan` default). Arrows:
depth and temperature; points: centroids of the substrate classes.

```{r figS4, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
site_scores <- as_tibble(scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2)) %>% bind_cols(rda_data)

arrows_cont <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_model, display = "bp", scaling = 2))
arrows_cont <- arrows_cont[rownames(arrows_cont) %in% c("depth", "temperature"), ] %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  mutate(Label = recode(Variable, depth = "Depth", temperature = "Temperature"),
         RDA1 = RDA1 * rda_arrow_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * rda_arrow_scale)
centroids <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_model, display = "cn", scaling = 2)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  mutate(Label = str_remove(Variable, "^Substrate"))

variance <- summary(rda_model)$cont$importance["Proportion Explained", c("RDA1", "RDA2")]
axis_title <- function(axis) sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", axis, 100 * variance[[axis]])

location_lines <- c("In" = "solid", "Out" = "dashed")

figureS4_plot <- ggplot(site_scores, aes(RDA1, RDA2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70") +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Location, linetype = Location), data = filter(site_scores, Location == "In"),
               colour = location_cols[["In"]], level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Location, linetype = Location), data = filter(site_scores, Location == "Out"),
               colour = location_cols[["Out"]], level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Canyon, shape = Location), size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_segment(data = arrows_cont, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.22, "cm")), linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = centroids, aes(RDA1, RDA2), shape = 23, size = 4, fill = "white", colour = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(data = bind_rows(arrows_cont, centroids), aes(RDA1, RDA2, label = Label),
                  family = font_family, fontface = "bold", size = fig_sizes$annotation + 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey60", segment.size = 0.3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = canyon_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("In" = 16, "Out" = 17), guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = location_lines, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_2dec) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_2dec) +
  labs(x = axis_title("RDA1"), y = axis_title("RDA2")) +
  theme_panel

legend_rda <- legend_panel(
  ggplot(tibble(Canyon   = factor(canyon_levels, levels = canyon_levels),
                Location = factor(c("In", "Out", "Out"), levels = location_levels),
                x = 0, y = 0), aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Canyon), alpha = 0, size = 3.5) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = Location), alpha = 0, size = 3.5) +
    geom_line(aes(linetype = Location, group = Location), alpha = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = canyon_cols, name = "Canyon:",
                        guide = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(alpha = 1, shape = 16))) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("In" = 16, "Out" = 17), name = "Position:",
                       guide = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = location_lines, name = "Ellipse (95%):",
                          guide = guide_legend(order = 3, override.aes = list(
                            alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.8, colour = unname(location_cols)))),
  scale = 1.1)

figureS4 <- figureS4_plot + legend_rda + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 0.25))
figureS4

save_figure(figureS4, "Figure S4", width = 10.5, height = 9)
```
